body.name: Observable synchronized Zhang--Dai construction handle
body.construction: \(\mathsf{Hdl}_{\mathrm{SI}}\): start from Zhang's rules R0--R10 on the observational signature on \(U_0=V\), which is associated with \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}=\mathcal L_{\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1)\), and on each \(k\in[K]\) full signature on \(U_k\), which is associated with the pooled selected law \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\). Compute \(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{sel}}(\mathcal O)\) from intervention-created adjacencies and observational-unshielded-noncollider closure, then propagate forbidden signature transitions only along shortest uncovered paths certified by \(\operatorname{Reach}_{\mathrm{cert},\mathcal O}\). Enforce Dai et al.'s Lemma 5 disjunction \(Z_k=T_k(\eta)\cup((F_k(\eta)\setminus T_k(\eta))\cap A(\eta))\) only as a witness obligation, without identifying \(T_k(\eta)\) with \(Z_k\). Use \(L_{A(\eta)}\), \(\operatorname{RepGraph}(\eta,B)\), and \(\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)\) only in the completeness proof to extend or oppose marks after an observable rule fires; none is a rule premise. The handle derives the finite list in \(\Lambda_{\mathrm{SI}}\) from observable predicates alone.
